title: Holodomor
summary: Wikidata item Q165058, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "man-made famine in Soviet Ukraine in 1932–33 that killed as many as seven million Ukrainians". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
